Mr. J. L. Johnson, P.E. Acting Chief, Engineering Division Department of the Army Fort Worth District, Corps of Engineers P. O. Box 17300 Fort Worth, Texas 76102
ATTENTION: SWFED-PR
Dear Mr. Johnson:
Your letter dated April 22, 1976, addressed to Mayor Rodrigues, has been forwarded to me for response.
The City of Eagle Pass would like to express its concerned relative to any project that would appreciably effect the normal water level of the Rio Grande River as it flows through the City of Eagle Pass. We have three major concerns; (1) the intake and holding facility for our portable water supply, (2) Shelby Park located in the Vega near the river, (3) the present 9-hole Golf Course and the anticipated expansion of the same.
While your letter dated April 22, 1976, does not detail the magnitude of the Amistad Lake hydroelectric generator project, we anticipate there will be detailed information made available to our City at a latter date. Meanwhile, if the City of Eagle Pass can supply you with additional information and support of our local facilities, we would be happy to do so.
Thank you for the opportunity of responding. We remain,
Respectfully yours,
I V V V V V
. Brown Manager
